zh_summary: AI 拋售是關於現金流、融資成本及等待回報的時間，而非需求消失。需求依然強勁：SK hynix 第三季營收 104.6 兆韓元（同比 +328%），營業利潤 83.3 兆韓元，利潤率約 80%，DRAM/HBM 至 2029 年售罄。Anthropic 單位經濟大幅改善，首次季度營業利潤。超大規模業者 Amazon、Alphabet、Meta 維持或上調 2026 年資本支出，仍無法滿足全部需求。市場關注負自由現金流及融資缺口。納斯達克追蹤市盈率處於二十幾倍，對比 2000 年的 190 倍。
text:
The AI selloff is not about demand evaporating. It is about cash flow, financing cost and how long the market is willing to wait for the returns.

Demand signals remain extremely strong.

SK hynix just reported Q3 revenue of 104.6 trillion won (+328% YoY) and operating profit of 83.3 trillion won with an ~80% margin. Management said DRAM and HBM volumes are effectively sold out through 2029, customer HBM requests are roughly double what they can supply, and they expect the supply shortage to persist through 2030. Long-term agreements already cover more than half of 2027–2028 capacity with 14 major customers. That is not a demand problem.⁠

Anthropic’s S-1 shows the unit economics at the model layer improving sharply. text:
Gold’s 30% Drop Matches 2008, but a Bottom Is Near | Tavi Costa

Taken as one sector, #gold miners would have the cleanest balance sheets in the stock market, says Tavi Costa @TaviCosta , yet mining makes up less than 1% of it. The founder and CEO of Azuria Capital calls this pullback “one of the most compelling windows of opportunities” he has seen this cycle, and with gold down about 30% by his count, he thinks “we’re closer to the bottom.”

Speaking with Kitco News anchor Jeremy Szafron at the New Orleans Investment Conference, Costa points to free cash flow yields near 10% and bank models that still value the miners on $3,000 to $3,500 gold. Plug in a higher long-term price, he argues, and the whole industry gets re-rated. He is especially drawn to silver miners, some holding 10% to 15% of their market cap in cash, and he sees resources as the new moat in a world AI can disrupt, calling mining “the best AI trade.”

text:
I have somewhat different view than most having cut my options teeth on a dispersion book during the tech bubble.  

The index vol short half of the short correlation trade was always a choice in terms of its sizing.  Back then IV/RV premium was pretty narrow unlike today so every unit of Vega sold in index was managed carefully.  Being short index vol was a coin flip sort of trade. @robin_j_brooks is correct in this analysis. This is a regime shift, not a blip.

For most of 2026, oil up meant yields up. Inflation expectations fed straight into the long end. That link is now broken. The 20-day correlation between Brent and the 10Y has collapsed to its lowest since late 2024.

The reason is Europe. The French 10-year is at 4.96%, the highest since 2002. The spread over German Bunds has widened to 159bp, the widest since 2011. French debt-to-GDP is 117%, versus 90% at the last crisis peak.

Bessent confirmed this week that capital is leaving "concerning" jurisdictions and flowing into Treasuries as a safe haven. The US is catching a bid because the alternative is worse.

text:
Binance lost about $6.3 billion in Thursday's hack. It is the largest crypto theft on record in dollar terms, roughly four times the $1.5 billion taken from Bybit in February 2025.

The drain started at 4:05 PM ET on Oct 29. TRM Labs says most of it left Binance wallets in about 20 minutes, across 10 blockchains.

Binance has set aside $6.34 billion to cover users. $5 billion of that is already held in the exact tokens that were stolen, about 80% of the loss. It is buying the rest through the market and OTC desks.

About $3 billion has been frozen on-chain, almost all of it $USDT and $USDC. The attacker still holds 18,270 $BTC split across 19 wallets. Elliptic says none of it has reached an exchange or service yet.

TRM and Chainalysis attribute the theft with high confidence to TraderTraitor, a North Korean state hacking unit. No government has confirmed it. Trump on Friday: "We don't know. We're looking at that." The FBI and Secret Service are both involved.

TRM counts $12.8 billion stolen by North Korea since 2017. $7.4 billion of it came this year.

Binance is targeting a phased restart of withdrawals early Sunday. Proof of reserves results are due Monday.

text:
"You're not arbitraging anything."

Dan Held says the price gap between crypto exchanges isn't arbitrage, but a premium traders are paid for taking on counterparty risk

"I was talking to some arbitrage traders in crypto, and I'm like, you're not arbitraging anything."

"What you are arbing is the exchange counterparty risk, because you're putting funds at risk, and there's a small premium or discount because of that risk."

"To do that trade, you have to have funds on every exchange at all times. Both the token that you're trying to arbitrage and dollars of some sort."

"We saw this with Mt. Gox and Bitstamp. Back in the day, coins on Mt. Gox traded higher than Bitstamp. The reason why is that Mt. Gox's fiat legs, the ability to wire money out, had withdrawal issues. The only way to get your money out was to buy Bitcoin."

"And what we learned is that there's no arbitrage at all there. It was counterparty risk."
